# Big Boys Junk Removal — full site index

Big Boys Junk Removal serves Atlanta, Suwanee, and surrounding Metro Atlanta communities. The company removes furniture, appliances, mattresses, hot tubs, yard waste, construction debris, household junk, and commercial material. Customers may estimate a job by individual item or by the portion of a 16-foot by 7-foot trailer required.

## Contact

- Phone: (470) 660-6874
- Email: support@bigboysjr.com
- Website: https://bigboysjr.com/
- Atlanta: 3201 Henderson Mill Road, Atlanta, GA 30341
- Suwanee: 2317 Breton Hunt Lane, Suwanee, GA 30024

## Quote process

1. Choose item pricing or load-size pricing.
2. Select items or an estimated trailer fraction.
3. Add job details such as stairs, disassembly, or same-day priority.
4. Review the itemized estimated price.
5. Enter contact, address, date, and time-window preferences to prepare a booking request.

The site does not promise a time slot until Big Boys confirms availability and scope.

## Services

- General junk removal: mixed household junk and bulky unwanted material.
- Furniture removal: couches, tables, chairs, dressers, bed frames, and similar pieces.
- Appliance removal: refrigerators, freezers, washers, dryers, and other household appliances.
- Mattress removal: mattresses, box springs, and related bed components.
- Hot tub removal: bulky spas and related equipment.
- Yard waste removal: branches, bagged yard material, and outdoor debris.
- Cleanouts: garages, basements, estates, rentals, storage areas, and larger property clearing.
- Construction debris: nonhazardous renovation and construction material.
- Commercial junk removal: office, retail, warehouse, and business cleanouts.

## Service areas

Primary hubs are Atlanta and Suwanee. Supporting pages cover Marietta, Decatur, Roswell, Alpharetta, Buford, Lawrenceville, Sandy Springs, Kennesaw, Smyrna, Tucker, Clarkston, Chamblee, Brookhaven, and Stone Mountain.

## Reviews and trust

The supplied Google Business Profile export reports a 4.9 rating from 127 reviews. Review excerpts on the site mention prompt same-day availability, careful crews, clear communication, efficient work, and polite service. Big Boys describes its crews as insured and background checked.
